item.title: Basic Dexxer
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Dexxer is a simple and reliable melee template built around Chivalry, weapon damage, and strong self-sustain.

It can be adapted to several different weapon styles, making it a good starting point for players who want a traditional melee character without committing to a highly specialized setup.

Aspect Options

Recommended Aspect options include:

  • Water
  • Earth
  • Fire
  • Discipline
  • Holy

The best choice depends on the weapon and playstyle being used.

item.title: Poisoner
item.description:
Overview

The Poisoner is a melee-focused poison build centered around Fencing, Poisoning, and Alchemy.

The character applies poison to enemies while using melee attacks to maintain pressure. The build can kite when necessary while still having the durability to remain in melee range.

Aspect Options

Poison is the required Aspect for this build.

The Aspect directly supports the build’s primary Poison damage strategy.

Link Options

Recommended Chain Links include:

  • Damage to Poisoned
  • Slayer/Dungeon Damage
  • Poison Damage
  • Melee Special Chance

Highly accurate weapons or additional Melee Special Chance links may also be necessary depending on equipment and hit chance.
